description: The bar chart illustrates model accuracy across a set of probing conditions, showing paired bars for each condition. The horizontal axis contains the categorical conditions (rotated labels) in the following left-to-right order: “1st layer,” “random layers,” “random layers +B2,” “random layers +L2,” “random layers +R2,” “random layers +permute,” “random,” “random +B2,” “random +L2,” “random +R2,” “random +permute,” and “unperturbed.” The vertical axis is labeled “Accuracy” and uses a linear scale spanning approximately 70 to 95, with tick marks at 70, 75, 80, 85, 90, and 95. Each category has two adjacent bars: for “1st layer,” a light blue bar at about 80 and a darker blue bar at about 82; for “random layers,” a light blue bar at about 82 and a darker blue bar at about 82; for “random layers +B2,” “+L2,” “+R2,” and “+permute,” the left bars are light green at about 79.5–79.7 and the right bars are darker green at about 81.4–81.8; for “random,” “random +B2,” “random +L2,” “random +R2,” and “random +permute,” the left bars are light red/pink at about 71.6–72.0 and the right bars are darker red at about 73.1–73.5; and for “unperturbed,” the left bar is light orange at about 90.3 and the right bar is darker orange at about 91.8. The bars are not presented as stacked, there is no visible legend, and there are no special annotations or visual emphasis beyond the consistent color pairing within each category.
